basic_profile.bio: I'm a recent college graduate with a degree in Business Administration, currently based in Austin, Texas. I am passionate about finding my first full-time role in project management. I enjoy exploring different cultures, which is why I frequently visit subreddits about Denmark and spiritual growth like AbrahamHicks. Despite my hectic job search, I spend evenings and weekends browsing Reddit, often between 7 PM and midnight. I'm single and enjoy connecting with people online who share my interests.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My academic background in business has provided me with foundational knowledge in management and operations. I have also taken online courses to improve my skills in digital project management. I frequently seek advice from forums and communities online to enhance my understanding of various job markets.
